title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 4,351–4,400 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 物流運籌學；物流配送管理

examples.en: E-commerce giants invest heavily in smart logistics to achieve six-hour island-wide delivery.
examples.zh: 電商龍頭投入巨資升級智慧物流運籌系統，力拼全台都會區六小時內極速到貨。

examples.en: Effective logistics management ensures fresh produce travels from farm to grocery shelves within 24 hours.
examples.zh: 高效的物流管理確保生鮮蔬果能在二十四小時內從產地農場直送超市貨架。

examples.en: The university launched a master's program dedicated to digital supply chain engineering and global logistics.
examples.zh: 該國立大學設立了專門培育數位供應鏈工程與全球運籌物流專業人才的碩士學程。

words.definition: 供應鏈韌性；彈性復原力

examples.en: Semiconductor manufacturers build multi-sourced supply chain resilience against geopolitical disruptions.
examples.zh: 半導體晶圓大廠積極建構具備多元供應商的供應鏈韌性，以從容應對地緣政治與斷鏈風險。

examples.en: Dual-sourcing raw materials enhances operational resilience when unexpected factory fires occur.
examples.zh: 關鍵原物料採取雙重來源供應商策略，能於突發工廠火災或停產時大幅提升營運韌性與復原力。

examples.en: Stress-testing inventory buffers helps multinational firms evaluate their resilience during natural disasters.
examples.zh: 針對安全庫存緩衝進行極限壓力測試，有助於跨國企業評估面臨重大天災時的抗風險彈性。

words.definition: 電商倉儲物流履行；履行實現

examples.en: Robotic fulfillment centers process tens of thousands of online shopping parcels every hour.
examples.zh: 配備高度自動化機器人的大型電商物流履行中心（Fulfillment Center）每小時高效處理數萬件網購包裹。

examples.en: Fast order fulfillment has become a primary competitive battleground for modern e-commerce platforms.
examples.zh: 極速精準的訂單履行能力，已成為現代各大電商平台兵家必爭的核心競爭焦點。

examples.en: Outscoring warehouse fulfillment to a third-party partner allows boutique brands to focus on marketing.
examples.zh: 將倉儲理貨與包裝出貨外包給專業第三方物流履行業者，能讓新創設計品牌全力專注於產品行銷。

words.definition: 自動化立體倉儲檢索 (AS/RS)；取回

examples.en: Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS) stack pallets twenty meters high with robotic precision.
examples.zh: 高科技自動化立體倉儲系統（AS/RS）能精準在二十公尺高的立體貨架間高速存取搬運重型棧板。

examples.en: Rapid robotic retrieval eliminates the need for manual picking ladders in high-density warehouses.
examples.zh: 機器人全自動高速存取撿貨技術，徹底免除了在高密度立體倉儲中使用人工攀爬登高梯的風險。

examples.en: The software optimizes retrieval routes so automated cranes fetch goods with minimal energy consumption.
examples.zh: 控制軟體精密最佳化取件路徑，讓自動化穿梭起重機以最低的耗電量完成最快速度的棧板搬移。

words.definition: 手持式條碼掃描槍；掃描器

examples.en: Warehouse operators use wireless handheld barcode scanners to register inbound packages instantly.
examples.zh: 倉儲理貨人員手持無線雷射條碼掃描槍，一秒精準刷讀條碼完成進貨入庫系統登記。

examples.en: If the optical scanner fails to read a smudged barcode, workers enter tracking IDs manually.
examples.zh: 若光學掃描器因外箱條碼髒污受損而無法辨識，作業員則需以手動輸入貨態追蹤碼。

examples.en: Modern Bluetooth ring scanners allow stockroom workers to keep both hands entirely free while sorting.
examples.zh: 新型藍牙指環式微型掃描器讓倉管人員在搬運分類包裹時，能完全空出雙手大幅提升作業效率。

words.definition: 庫存盤點；存貨清冊

examples.en: Real-time cloud software tracks inventory levels across all retail stores and central warehouses.
examples.zh: 雲端 ERP 即時進銷存系統能同步動態監控全台數百家連鎖實體門市與中央大倉的庫存水位。

examples.en: Conducting an annual physical inventory count helps accounting verify discrepancies with system records.
examples.zh: 每年定期舉行全公司實體庫存全面盤點，有助於會計部門確實稽核實體存貨與系統帳面數字的差異。

examples.en: Lean manufacturing models minimize idle inventory to reduce costly warehouse storage overhead.
examples.zh: 精實生產管理模式致力於將閒置在庫庫存降至最低，從而大幅削減高昂的倉儲空間與租金負擔。

words.definition: 缺貨斷貨；庫存售罄

examples.en: Automated reordering algorithms prevent catastrophic stockouts during Singles' Day shopping sales.
examples.zh: 智慧自動補貨演算法能在大數據精準預測下提前進貨，防止雙十一購物節爆單時發生缺貨斷貨。

examples.en: A sudden stockout of baby formula caused widespread frustration among young parents.
examples.zh: 暢銷進口嬰兒配方奶粉突如其來的嚴重缺貨斷貨，在新手爸媽社群中引發了極大的焦慮與不滿。

examples.en: Retailers face lost revenue and damaged reputation whenever popular items suffer unexpected stockouts.
examples.zh: 每當熱銷明星商品無預警面臨斷貨缺貨窘境時，零售商不僅損失大筆營收，更會重創顧客滿意度。

words.definition: 庫存積壓；過量進貨

examples.en: Clearance discount promotions clear overstock winter apparel before spring collections arrive.
examples.zh: 換季特賣清倉優惠活動能在春裝上市前，迅速出清冬季保暖大衣與羽絨外套的積壓庫存。

examples.en: The warehouse manager warned against ordering excess units that could overstock seasonal displays.
examples.zh: 倉庫主管向採購部門發出警示，切勿盲目超量進貨導致季節性陳列架出現嚴重的庫存囤積。

examples.en: Liquidation brokers purchase bulk overstock electronics at steep discounts to resell on secondary markets.
examples.zh: 庫存清算商以極低的折數整批收購廠商大量積壓的電子零組件，並轉售至二級流通市場。

words.definition: 進貨入庫的；入境進站的

examples.en: The receiving dock inspects inbound container shipments for quality and packaging damage.
examples.zh: 倉儲碼頭驗貨專區針對每日抵達的進貨入庫海運貨櫃進行嚴格的封條核對與外箱完整性檢驗。

examples.en: Inbound freight from overseas ports experienced a forty-eight hour customs clearance delay.
examples.zh: 來自海外港口的進口入庫海運貨櫃，因海關抽驗程序在國門發生了四十八小時的通關延誤。

examples.en: Logistics supervisors log every inbound truck arrival to prevent traffic jams around the depot gates.
examples.zh: 物流中心主管詳細登錄每一輛進貨大貨車的抵達進場時程，以防園區大門外發生車輛回堵大塞車。

words.definition: 出貨出庫的；出境離站的

examples.en: Fleets of delivery trucks line up at loading docks for afternoon outbound distribution.
examples.zh: 數十輛宅配貨車在物流出貨碼頭排成整齊長龍，準備裝載當日午後出貨發往全台各營業所。

examples.en: All outbound packages pass through automatic weigh scales before being loaded onto transport containers.
examples.zh: 所有待出庫的宅配包裹在正式裝上長途運輸聯結車前，均會經過自動動態地磅秤重檢核。

examples.en: Peak outbound shipping volume surges dramatically during national shopping festivals.
examples.zh: 每逢全國性網購年終促銷旺季，物流園區的出貨發運總量往往呈現數倍以上的爆發性激增。

words.definition: 倉庫撿貨作業；採摘

examples.en: Pick-to-light LED shelves guide workers to execute rapid, error-free item picking.
examples.zh: 導入「電子標籤播種式揀貨系統」（Pick-to-Light），透過亮燈指示導引作業員零失誤高速撿貨。

examples.en: Order picking accounts for over fifty percent of total labor costs in traditional manual warehouses.
examples.zh: 在傳統全人工倉儲作業中，撿貨理貨環節往往占據了整體倉儲人力營運成本的百分之五十以上。

examples.en: Autonomous mobile robots assist pickers by bringing mobile shelf racks directly to static picking stations.
examples.zh: 自主移動機器人（AMR）透過「貨到人」先進模式將活動貨架直接搬運至固定撿貨工作站，免去人員徒步奔波。

words.definition: 防震緩衝氣墊包材；緩衝墊

examples.en: Eco-friendly inflatable air cushioning pouches protect fragile ceramic mugs during express transit.
examples.zh: 在紙箱內塞滿環保充氣防震緩衝氣墊袋，能確保脆弱的陶瓷馬克杯在高速快遞運輸中完好無損。

examples.en: Biodegradable cornstarch packing peanuts provide sustainable cushioning inside shipping boxes.
examples.zh: 採用天然玉米澱粉製成的生物可降解泡泡粒，為網購寄件包裹提供了環保無毒的防震緩衝保護。

examples.en: Adding adequate protective cushioning prevents sensitive medical devices from jarring vibration shocks.
examples.zh: 在外箱內填充足量且緊實的防震緩衝材料，能防止精密醫療器材在長途顛簸中受到劇烈震盪受損。

words.definition: 包裹即時貨態追蹤；追蹤

examples.en: Customers enter the 12-digit tracking number online to check their parcel's real-time transit status.
examples.zh: 消費者在手機網頁輸入十二碼包裹追蹤號碼，即可秒查包裹目前是在理貨中、運輸中或已抵達超商。

examples.en: GPS tracking on refrigerated trucks ensures perishable meats never sit too long in the summer heat.
examples.zh: 低溫冷凍物流車輛上裝設的全時 GPS 衛星定位追蹤系統，確保易腐肉品絕不在高溫炎日下異常滯留。

examples.en: Push notifications deliver instant tracking updates whenever a parcel departs the local distribution center.
examples.zh: 每當網購包裹自當地物流營業所出發配送時，手機 App 就會即時發送最新貨態進度推播通知。

words.definition: 自動化高速包裹分揀；分類

examples.en: Cross-belt sorting machines scan barcodes and divert 20,000 packages per hour by zip code.
examples.zh: 交叉帶式高速自動分揀機透過頂部條碼相機，每小時將兩萬件包裹依郵遞區號自動分流至專屬滑道。

examples.en: Efficient parcel sorting reduces turnaround times and prevents misrouted delivery shipments.
examples.zh: 高度精準的包裹自動分揀能大幅縮短轉運時效，並徹底防止送錯營業所導致的錯運繞路延誤。

examples.en: The newly opened hub features three levels of high-speed mechanical sorting conveyor tracks.
examples.zh: 全新啟用的旗艦轉運轉運中心配備了三層立體高速機械分揀輸送軌道，具備超強全天候吞吐量。

words.definition: 貨運棧板；托盤

examples.en: Standardized wooden pallets are wrapped securely with plastic stretch film for ocean transit.
examples.zh: 標準規格歐洲木質貨運棧板上堆滿貨物後，以高韌性伸縮保鮮膜緊緊纏繞加固以便海運裝櫃。

examples.en: Workers use hydraulic hand jacks to move heavy pallets across flat concrete factory floors.
examples.zh: 現場作業員運用油壓拖板車，能輕鬆在平整的水泥廠區地面上拖動重達一噸的貨物棧板。

examples.en: Heavy items are systematically arranged on each pallet to prevent tipping during forklift transit.
examples.zh: 重型沉重的箱裝貨物在棧板上均依力學對稱堆疊整齊，嚴防在堆高機高速搬運轉彎時傾斜傾覆。

words.definition: 電動堆高機；叉車

examples.en: Certified forklift drivers skillfully maneuver heavy cargo through narrow warehouse aisles.
examples.zh: 領有國家重機械操作執照的堆高機司機熟練穿梭於狹窄高架貨架走道間，精準升降沉重棧板。

examples.en: Electric forklifts emit zero toxic exhaust fumes, making them ideal for enclosed indoor distribution centers.
examples.zh: 全電動堆高機具備零廢氣排放與低噪音優勢，是封閉式室內物流轉運中心最理想的搬運機具。

examples.en: Always wear high-visibility vests and sound the horn when driving a forklift around warehouse corners.
examples.zh: 駕駛堆高機行經任何視線死角轉角處時，切記務必穿著反光背心並按鳴喇叭示警以策安全。

words.definition: 越庫作業（不落地直轉出庫）

examples.en: Cross-docking transfers fresh milk directly from incoming supplier trucks to outbound delivery vans.
examples.zh: 採用先進的越庫作業模式（Cross-Docking），新鮮牧場鮮奶抵達後無需入庫直接轉裝上配送車。

examples.en: Implementing cross-docking slashes warehouse storage fees and dramatically speeds order turnaround.
examples.zh: 實施高週轉的越庫作業模式能大幅縮減昂貴的倉租停留費用，並極大化縮短訂單出庫的作業時間。

examples.en: Fast-moving seasonal fruit relies on cross-docking docks to preserve freshness and reduce cold-chain time.
examples.zh: 具備高時效性的產地當季新鮮水果極度仰賴越庫碼頭快轉，盡可能減少冷鏈停頓時間並保鮮。

words.definition: 貨運運輸；貨物；運費

examples.en: Ocean freight rates fluctuated significantly due to global shipping lane congestion.
examples.zh: 受到全球主要航道塞港與紅海危機影響，遠洋貨櫃海運運價指數出現劇烈波動與調漲。

examples.en: Shippers can compare international air freight versus sea freight quotes before booking cargo space.
examples.zh: 進出口貿易商在正式下單訂艙前，通常會詳細比對國際航空貨運與海運貨櫃的報價與航程時效。

examples.en: Customs duties and local freight charges should be factored into the landed cost of imported electronics.
examples.zh: 計算海外進口電子消費品的實到到岸總成本時，必須將進口關稅與國內段貨運費用精準計入。

words.definition: 航空貨物；船舶載貨

examples.en: Dedicated Boeing 777 cargo freighters transport temperature-sensitive vaccines and high-end electronics.
examples.zh: 波音 777 全貨機以恆溫冷藏貨艙長途直飛，安全載運溫控生技疫苗與高價值晶圓電子元件。

examples.en: Dockworkers secured the oversized machinery cargo with heavy steel chains inside the ship's hold.
examples.zh: 碼頭裝卸工人在萬噸貨輪底層深艙內，使用重型防鏽鋼索牢固綁紮固定超重超寬的工業機械載貨。

examples.en: Air cargo demand often surges during the fourth quarter ahead of global Christmas shopping peaks.
examples.zh: 全球航空貨運業務需求在第四季往往迎來年度高峰，全力備戰各國聖誕年終送禮採購潮。

words.definition: 標準海運貨櫃；容器

examples.en: Thousands of forty-foot steel containers are loaded onto mega container ships by giant gantry cranes.
examples.zh: 碼頭巨型岸邊橋式起重機以驚人效率將數千只四十呎標準鋼製貨櫃吊裝至兩萬箱級超大型貨櫃輪上。

examples.en: Shipping lines inspect each empty container for floor damage or waterproof leaks prior to releasing it.
examples.zh: 船運航商在放行空貨櫃給出口工廠提領裝貨前，均會仔細檢查櫃底木板完整度與水密密封性。

examples.en: Refrigerated containers, or reefers, maintain precise sub-zero temperatures throughout tropical voyages.
examples.zh: 冷藏冷凍專用貨櫃（Reefer）即便航行於酷熱的熱帶赤道海域，也能一路維持精準零下的保鮮低溫。

words.definition: 港口貨櫃碼頭；航廈；終端

examples.en: Kaohsiung Port Terminal 7 operates Taiwan's first fully automated remote-controlled container yard.
examples.zh: 高雄港第七貨櫃中心引進全自動無人化遠端控制橋吊與自走車，打造全台首座世界級智慧碼頭。

examples.en: The modern cargo terminal processes import declarations around the clock to prevent tarmac congestion.
examples.zh: 現代化航空貨運航廈全天候二十四小時不間斷審驗進口報單，全力防止機場停機坪貨物積壓堵塞。

examples.en: Thousands of trucks enter the port terminal gates every morning to drop off export containers.
examples.zh: 每天清晨數以千計的大卡車浩浩蕩蕩駛進港口貨櫃碼頭通關閘口，依序交卸即將裝船出口的貨櫃。

words.definition: 海關報關查驗；關稅

examples.en: Cross-border parcels undergo automated X-ray security scanning and customs clearance checks.
examples.zh: 每一件搭機抵達國門的跨境網購包裹皆必須通過高速 X 光安檢機掃描與海關嚴格報關審驗。

examples.en: All passengers carrying undeclared foreign currency exceeding regulatory limits will be detained by customs.
examples.zh: 旅客攜帶超出法定限額且未誠實申報的外幣現鈔通關入境時，一律將依法遭海關攔截沒入裁罰。

examples.en: Experienced brokers guide importers through complex customs classification codes and documentation.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的專業報關行人員協助進口商精確申報繁瑣的各類海關商品稅則號列與產地證明文件。

words.definition: 易利委 (EZ WAY 實名認證 App)

examples.en: Taiwanese shoppers use the EZ WAY app for quick mobile real-name declaration on overseas packages.
examples.zh: 台灣民眾跨境網購必備「EZ WAY 易利委」App，手指輕輕一點即可完成海外包裹實名委任報關。

examples.en: You will receive a mobile push notification from EzWay asking to confirm the contents of incoming airmail.
examples.zh: 每當有海外空運郵包抵台報關時，手機便會收到來自 EzWay 易利委的推播要求核對申報明細。

examples.en: Registering your national identification number on EzWay prevents identity theft by unauthorized importers.
examples.zh: 在 EzWay 易利委完成身分證實名認證綁定，能有效防止不肖業者冒用您的個資進行虛假進口報關。

words.definition: 進口報關申報單；宣告

examples.en: Falsifying invoice values on import customs declarations violates national trade regulations.
examples.zh: 在進口海關報關申報單上低報商品發票價值以圖逃漏稅，屬於違法行為將面臨高額罰鍰。

examples.en: Travelers must submit an accurate currency declaration before walking through the red inspection channel.
examples.zh: 攜帶超額現鈔或高價應稅管制品之旅客，在走入海關紅線查驗櫃檯前必須填寫正確申報單。

examples.en: The electronic declaration system automatically cross-references submitted cargo lists against shipping manifests.
examples.zh: 海關電子申報審核系統會自動將報關行上傳的貨物清單，與航商申報的艙單提單進行大數據勾稽。

words.definition: 進口關稅；關稅稅率

examples.en: Luxury leather handbags imported from Europe are subject to statutory import tariffs and VAT.
examples.zh: 從歐洲空運進口的高級名牌真皮精品包款，依法須繳納法定進口關稅與百分之五營業稅。

examples.en: Reducing preferential trade tariffs lowered the domestic retail price of imported electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 降低特定雙邊優惠關稅稅率，能顯著帶動海外進口純電動車在國內實體門市的降價讓利。

examples.en: Free trade agreements often eliminate reciprocal tariffs across agricultural and industrial commodities.
examples.zh: 簽訂自由貿易協定通常能在締約國之間全面免除絕大多數農工產品的進口關稅，促進貿易繁榮。

words.definition: 海關禁運違禁品；走私品

examples.en: Customs detector dogs sniff out illegal contraband such as undeclared fresh meat and drugs.
examples.zh: 機場海關專業檢疫犬在行李轉盤靈敏嗅聞，嚴格查緝未申報的豬肉生鮮與各類走私違禁品。

examples.en: Coast guard patrols intercepted a suspicious fishing boat smuggling duty-unpaid liquor and tobacco contraband.
examples.zh: 海巡特勤巡邏艇在海面上強勢攔截一艘形跡可疑的走私漁船，當場起獲大量未稅私酒洋菸走私違禁品。

examples.en: Attempting to bring agricultural contraband across the national border can lead to severe financial penalties.
examples.zh: 任何企圖夾帶未經檢疫之動植物農產品違禁品跨越國門入境者，最高將面臨百萬元之巨額罰鍰。

words.definition: 冷藏冷凍專用的；冷卻的

examples.en: Temperature-monitored refrigerated trucks transport fresh sashimi from fishing harbors to sushi restaurants.
examples.zh: 搭載即時衛星溫控回傳系統的低溫冷藏冷凍專車，每日清晨將東港現撈生魚片直送各大頂級壽司店。

examples.en: Vaccines must be held inside certified refrigerated storage units to maintain strict chemical potency.
examples.zh: 生物疫苗必須全程存放於經專業認證的超低溫醫藥冷藏儲存設備中，以確保藥物活性不受破壞。

examples.en: The online grocery service ships crisp organic greens in specialized refrigerated foam totes.
examples.zh: 生鮮電商配送團隊將清脆無毒的有機蔬菜妥善置於特製保溫冷藏蓄冷箱中，新鮮直達客戶餐桌。

words.definition: 溫度連續記錄器；伐木工

examples.en: A USB temperature data logger inside the medicine box confirms no temperature spikes occurred.
examples.zh: 隨精密生技藥品箱附帶的 USB 連續溫度記錄器，能下載完整溫度曲線證實運送全程完全未失溫。

examples.en: The technician downloaded PDF delivery audit reports directly from the compact digital temperature logger.
examples.zh: 現場品管檢驗人員直接自小巧的手持數位溫度記錄器中下載 PDF 格式的履歷監控報表進行驗收。

examples.en: High-precision loggers record temperature and relative humidity continuously throughout the transatlantic flight.
examples.zh: 高精度溫濕度記錄儀在整個跨洋長途飛行過程中，每隔三分鐘持續監控記錄貨艙內的溫濕度波動。

words.definition: 最後一哩路配送的

examples.en: Electric scooters are revolutionizing eco-friendly last-mile delivery across crowded city centers.
examples.zh: 靈巧安靜的換電式電動機車正掀起都會密集商圈「最後一哩路配送」（Last-Mile）的綠色減碳革命。

examples.en: Solving congestion during last-mile fulfillment represents the biggest logistical headache for urban couriers.
examples.zh: 如何妥善克服狹窄巷弄與尖峰大塞車的最後一哩路配送瓶頸，是都會區宅配司機最棘手的難題。

examples.en: The startup introduced autonomous sidewalk robots to address the rising labor cost of last-mile dispatch.
examples.zh: 這家科技新創推出了人行道自主無人外送車，全力降低都會末端最後一哩路配送攀升的人力成本。

words.definition: 宅配司機外送員；快遞員

examples.en: Courteous delivery couriers ring doorbells to deliver heavy parcels directly into living rooms.
examples.zh: 態度親切親民的黑貓宅急便配送司機熱情按響門鈴，親自將沉重的生活日用品包裹扛上樓送到家。

examples.en: The courier called my mobile number before ascending the stairway to confirm someone was home.
examples.zh: 宅配外送司機在爬樓梯上樓前先撥通了我的手機號碼，確認家中有人能即時開門簽收。

examples.en: During monsoon storms, dedicated couriers wear waterproof gear to ensure our packages arrive on schedule.
examples.zh: 即使碰上豪雨颱風天，敬業的快遞宅配員依然穿戴全套專業雨具穿梭風雨，使命必達準時送交。

words.definition: 門前台階；送貨到府 (Doorstep)

examples.en: Contactless doorstep delivery allows drivers to place parcels outside gates during flu seasons.
examples.zh: 防疫期間推行貼心的「無接觸門口配送」（Doorstep Delivery），外送員將包裹放於門口拍照確認。

examples.en: The driver snapped a clear confirmation photograph of the package resting safely on the doorstep.
examples.zh: 宅配員將包裹輕輕放置於住家門口玄關前，並順手拍照存證上傳系統作為完成送件的憑證。

examples.en: Having your weekly groceries delivered straight to your doorstep eliminates tedious supermarket commutes.
examples.zh: 每週訂購的柴米油鹽生鮮雜貨直接宅配到府送到門口，徹底免除了舟車勞頓往返大賣場的採買奔波。

words.definition: 智慧取件儲物櫃 (如 i郵箱)

examples.en: Chunghwa Post's iBox smart lockers let commuters retrieve online purchases 24/7 at train stations.
examples.zh: 中華郵政在各大捷運站與火車站廣設「i郵箱」智慧取件儲物櫃，方便通勤族全天候二十四小時隨到隨領。

examples.en: You simply scan a one-time QR code at the smart locker touch screen to unlock your compartment.
examples.zh: 只要在智慧取件櫃的觸控螢幕前掃描手機收到的專屬一次性 QR Code，專屬儲物櫃門便會自動彈開。

examples.en: Residential complexes are installing climate-controlled smart parcel lockers in entrance lobbies.
examples.zh: 越來越多新型高檔社區大樓在挑高氣派大廳設置低溫恆溫智慧取件置物櫃，方便住戶代收冷藏包裹。

words.definition: 超商取貨；取件；小貨卡

examples.en: Convenience store pickup and pay is Taiwan's most popular e-commerce fulfillment choice.
examples.zh: 遍布全台大街小巷的「四大超商取貨付款」是台灣網購消費者最熱愛且最便利的取貨選擇。

examples.en: Customers show their identity card at the checkout counter when claiming an unpaid store pickup order.
examples.zh: 當消費者前往超商門市領取已先線上刷卡付款的包裹時，需出示本人身分證件供店員核對身分。

examples.en: Over ten thousand retail convenience outlets offer flexible package drop-off and pickup around the island.
examples.zh: 全台超過一萬多家便利商店提供超高密度的寄件與取件服務，真正實現了二十四小時無休的便利生活。

words.definition: 貨到付款 (Cash On Delivery)

examples.en: Cash on Delivery (COD) builds trust for first-time shoppers who prefer paying after receipt.
examples.zh: 「貨到付款」（Cash On Delivery）為不習慣線上刷卡的初次購物消費者提供了收到貨再付現的安心保障。

examples.en: Because COD involves manual cash handling, delivery drivers must reconcile receipts at the end of the shift.
examples.zh: 由於貨到付款牽涉到現場現金交易找零，宅配司機在傍晚交班時必須仔細核對現鈔與送貨單據。

examples.en: The platform offers COD options to serve elderly shoppers without active credit cards.
examples.zh: 該購物網站貼心提供超商與宅配貨到付款功能，服務廣大沒有信用卡或偏好付現的銀髮族族群。

words.definition: 逆向物流；退貨流程；反向

examples.en: Frictionless reverse logistics enables hassle-free seven-day e-commerce product returns.
examples.zh: 建立順暢無阻的逆向物流（Reverse Logistics）回收機制，讓消費者享有超商七天鑑賞期免費退貨服務。

examples.en: The fashion retailer uses reverse logistics to inspect returned garments and restock pristine items.
examples.zh: 知名服飾電商透過健全的逆向物流退貨檢驗程序，迅速整新未剪標衣服並第一時間重新上架銷售。

examples.en: Streamlining reverse supply chains reduces landfill waste by channeling open-box returns into discount outlets.
examples.zh: 簡化並優化逆向物流回收處理流程，能將拆封未損之良品轉流至福利品暢貨中心，減少資源浪費。

words.definition: 一件代發模式；直運無庫存銷售

examples.en: Dropshipping allows boutique shops to sell goods shipped directly from manufacturers without holding inventory.
examples.zh: 採用「一件代發」（Dropshipping）電商模式，微型賣家無需自行承擔囤貨壓力，訂單由工廠直發買家。

examples.en: An entrepreneur built a lucrative lifestyle brand using dropshipping channels linked to overseas factories.
examples.zh: 這位年輕創業家透過無庫存一件代發模式串接海外製造工廠，成功創立了利潤豐厚的風格生活品牌。

examples.en: Quality control can be challenging in dropshipping since the seller never inspects the physical units personally.
examples.zh: 由於賣家在整個交易環節中無法親手拆箱驗貨，因此在代發模式下嚴格把控商品品質往往是最大挑戰。

words.definition: 訂單交貨前置期；生產交期

examples.en: Optimizing local warehouse automation shortened customer order lead times from three days to eight hours.
examples.zh: 全面升級區域物流中心自動化設備，成功將消費者從下單到收到貨的交貨前置期由三天縮減為八小時。

examples.en: Disruptions at raw material ports doubled our manufacturing lead time unexpectedly this quarter.
examples.zh: 上游原物料港口突發罷工封港，導致我們工廠本季的成品生產與出貨前置期被迫整整翻倍延宕。

examples.en: Customers appreciate manufacturers that provide accurate and reliable estimations for custom furniture lead times.
examples.zh: 當消費者訂購手工客製化實木家具時，工廠若能給予精確誠實的製作交期與交貨預估，將大獲好評。

words.definition: 準時的；按時準時送達

examples.en: The courier service maintains a stellar 99.4% on-time delivery rate even during peak holidays.
examples.zh: 該家專業宅配物流即便在春節與中秋送禮高峰繁盛期，依然維持著高達百分之九十九點四的超高準時送達率。

examples.en: Ensuring on-time arrival of critical medical supplies can be a life-or-death priority.
examples.zh: 確保緊急醫療救援物資與急救手術血液按時準點送達，往往是關乎病患生死一線間的極致考驗。

examples.en: Advanced telemetry alerts fleet coordinators if a truck falls behind its scheduled on-time delivery timetable.
examples.zh: 車載智慧遠程監控系統能在貨車運送進度落後於預定準時送達時刻表時，即時發出警示以利調度。

words.definition: 配送車隊；船隊；機隊

examples.en: The green delivery fleet replaced petrol scooters with electric battery-swapping bikes.
examples.zh: 這支主打永續環保的都會宅配車隊全面淘汰傳統燃油機車，換裝智慧換電式電動車以實踐綠色物流。

examples.en: The company manages a massive nationwide fleet comprising heavy trucks, vans, and cargo drones.
examples.zh: 這家大型綜合物流集團在全台調度營運著由重型聯結車、宅配貨車與貨運無人機組成的龐大車隊。

examples.en: Regular predictive maintenance prevents sudden breakdowns across the delivery fleet during peak seasons.
examples.zh: 透過大數據車輛預測性維修保養計畫，能全面杜絕大型物流配送車隊在節慶送貨高峰期於半路拋錨。

words.definition: 動態路徑最佳化；優化

examples.en: AI route optimization calculates traffic, avoiding congested bottlenecks to deliver parcels faster.
examples.zh: 運用 AI 智慧派車動態路徑最佳化演算法即時運算即時路況，巧妙避開壅塞路段並規劃最快配送路線。

examples.en: Warehouse inventory optimization ensures high-demand items are stored near the most accessible loading docks.
examples.zh: 倉儲庫存動線最佳化配置，確保最熱門暢銷的高週轉率商品皆擺放在最靠近出貨裝載碼頭的黃金貨架上。

examples.en: Mathematical optimization models help logistics managers balance packaging weight against fuel economy.
examples.zh: 透過嚴謹的運籌學數學最佳化模型，能協助物流規劃師在包裹包裝總重與貨車燃油經濟性間取得完美平衡。

words.definition: 自主無人導引的；自治的

examples.en: Autonomous delivery robots navigate pedestrian sidewalks to bring takeout meals to campus dormitories.
examples.zh: 具備雷達避障技術的自主無人外送機器人平穩行駛於人行道上，將熱騰騰的健康餐盒準確送達大學宿舍。

examples.en: Testing is currently underway for autonomous electric tractor-trailers driving on designated highway express lanes.
examples.zh: 政府與科技巨頭目前正在封閉國道專用路段上，積極測試全自動自主無人駕駛純電大型貨櫃車的行駛效能。

examples.en: High-definition LiDAR and stereoscopic cameras guide the autonomous robotic cart inside the distribution floor.
examples.zh: 高解析度光學雷達（LiDAR）與雙目立體相機精準導航，引導自動無人物流搬運車在廠區安全穿梭。

words.definition: 無人配送機；空拍無人機

examples.en: Medical delivery drones transport urgent blood supplies and vaccines to remote mountain clinics.
examples.zh: 醫療物資救難無人機在惡劣天候道路坍方中凌空起飛，迅速將緊急血袋與抗蛇毒血清空運至偏鄉衛生所。

examples.en: The post office piloted delivery drone flights to deliver mail across islands during stormy monsoon months.
examples.zh: 郵政總局在離島海峽間展開試飛實驗，利用長程快遞無人機在強烈東北季風季跨海空投重要緊急郵件。

examples.en: Battery range and regulatory airspace rules remain key challenges for commercial parcel delivery drones.
examples.zh: 電池續航里程限制與嚴格的都會空域民航法規，依然是商用包裹外送無人機普及前亟需克服的關鍵挑戰。

words.definition: 多包裹集運打包；合併

examples.en: International shoppers save freight costs by combining ten separate orders via parcel consolidation.
examples.zh: 海外跨境網購愛好者透過集運倉將十件散落包裹進行「多單合包集運」，大幅省下昂貴的國際運費。

examples.en: The freight forwarding hub performs cargo consolidation to fill an entire ocean container efficiently.
examples.zh: 國際海運貨運承攬轉運中心執行專業的散貨併櫃集運作業，將多家廠商的貨物拼合成一整只標準貨櫃。

examples.en: Package consolidation combines multiple loose boxes into a single reinforced crate for overseas transport.
examples.zh: 跨境集運系統將零散的多個小紙箱拆箱重新整理合併至特製加厚外箱中，大幅減輕海外長途運費。

words.definition: 庫存週轉速度；速度

examples.en: High supply chain velocity minimizes storage overhead and keeps trendy fashion products fresh.
examples.zh: 極高的供應鏈庫存週轉速度能大幅降低倉租管理成本，並讓快時尚服飾長保最新潮流行款上架。

examples.en: By accelerating payment and fulfillment, the marketplace platform boosted transaction velocity significantly.
examples.zh: 藉由全面加速金流審核與物流履約流程，該電商開店平台顯著推升了整體平台的線上交易週轉速度。

examples.en: Measuring the sales velocity of individual SKUs helps procurement forecast seasonal restocking quantities.
examples.zh: 定期精算每項商品單品（SKU）的平均銷售流速，能精準協助採購人員預估換季進貨時的最佳叫貨量。

words.definition: 商品條碼；條形碼

examples.en: Each carton carries a unique GS1 barcode encoding SKU, batch number, and expiration date.
examples.zh: 每個出貨外箱皆印有唯一的國際 GS1 條碼，完整記載商品料號、生產批號與有效保存期限。

examples.en: High-speed cameras read the barcode printed on moving boxes at speeds of three meters per second.
examples.zh: 架設於滾筒軌道上的高速視覺相機，能在包裹以每秒三公尺高速飛馳經過時瞬間精準判讀條碼內容。

examples.en: Printing high-contrast barcodes ensures scanning guns register package numbers with one quick pull.
examples.zh: 印刷高對比清晰黑白條碼，能確保理貨人員手持掃描槍在扣動扳機的瞬間，一鍵秒讀包裹貨號毫不費力。

words.definition: 自動化輸送帶；傳送帶

examples.en: High-speed powered roller conveyors transport sorted cartons directly into waiting truck containers.
examples.zh: 高速電動滾筒輸送帶將分揀完畢的紙箱源源不絕平穩輸送至停靠在月台的長途貨櫃聯結車內。

examples.en: An automatic diverter arm mounted beside the conveyor pushes parcels down the proper delivery chute.
examples.zh: 安裝於輸送帶旁的自動氣壓分流撥臂，能在千分之一秒內將包裹順暢推入專屬區域的傾斜滑道。

examples.en: Regular lubrication keeps the three-kilometer warehouse conveyor network operating smoothly without friction.
examples.zh: 定期施作機械潤滑與皮帶檢修，讓貫穿整座萬坪物流大倉長達三公里的輸送帶網絡終年流暢無阻運轉。

words.definition: 大型智慧倉儲；倉庫

examples.en: The climate-controlled mega warehouse spans thirty thousand square meters near Taoyuan Airport.
examples.zh: 坐落於桃園國際機場航空城旁的現代化大型恆溫溫控智慧倉儲，總樓地板面積超過三萬平方公尺。

examples.en: Modern warehouse architectures incorporate solar panels across the rooftop to generate clean electricity.
examples.zh: 現代化綠建築智慧大倉在廣闊的屋頂全面鋪設高效能太陽能光電板，全天候產生乾淨無污染的綠電。

examples.en: Security guards monitor hundreds of CCTV cameras guarding the bonded electronics warehouse around the clock.
examples.zh: 保全監控中心透過數百支高解析度全時監視相機，嚴密把關戒備儲放高價晶片的高科技保稅大倉。

words.definition: 倉儲物流作業效率；效能

examples.en: Deploying AI sorting robots boosted overall warehouse order processing efficiency by 300%.
examples.zh: 全面導入 AI 智慧分揀機器人後，使整個物流大倉的每日訂單出貨處理作業效率暴增了三倍以上。

examples.en: Reducing redundant paperwork significantly improved the daily dispatch efficiency of delivery drivers.
examples.zh: 大幅簡化繁複冗餘的紙本出貨單據簽核流程，顯著提升了外勤宅配司機每日出車派件的整體作業效率。

examples.en: Ergonomic packing tables increase worker comfort while maximizing carton packaging efficiency.
examples.zh: 符合人體工學高度的減壓包裝封箱作業台，在提升作業員舒適度之餘更能極大化出貨打包的效率。

words.definition: 準時安全送達可靠度；信賴度

examples.en: Consistent delivery reliability builds long-term customer trust for direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands.
examples.zh: 始終如一、風雨無阻的貨物安全送達可靠度，是 D2C 電商原生品牌贏得消費者長期忠誠信任的基石。

examples.en: The supply chain manager evaluated vendors based on cost, product quality, and shipping reliability.
examples.zh: 供應鏈資深協理依據報價成本、良品良率以及最重要的交期送貨可靠度，嚴格評選合格配合供應商。

examples.en: Automated backup systems ensure data center reliability even during city-wide electrical power outages.
examples.zh: 自動切換的雙迴路發電機與不斷電系統，確保雲端物流數據中心在全城無預警大停電時依然高度可靠運作。

words.definition: 全球物流互聯互通；連結性

examples.en: Taiwan's strategic maritime position provides seamless air-sea logistics connectivity across Asia.
examples.zh: 台灣得天獨厚的亞太地理樞紐位置，提供了串聯東北亞與東南亞無縫接軌的海空物流互聯互通優勢。

examples.en: Investing in 5G private networks provides uninterrupted warehouse connectivity for autonomous mobile robots.
examples.zh: 斥資部署高頻寬低延遲的 5G 企業專網，為全天候穿梭作業的立體無人搬運機器人提供零斷線的連網環境。

examples.en: Expanding direct rail freight improved overland logistics connectivity between inland production hubs and seaports.
examples.zh: 開拓專用鐵路貨運班列，大幅升級了內陸重點工業製造基地與沿海萬噸深水良港間的陸運互聯互通。
